The user wants to book a flight from LAX to JFK on November 15, 2024, business class, within $2400 budget. They have access token abc123xyz and card id id15583.

We need to check if they can afford it? We might need to fetch flight cost via get_flight_cost. Then compare against budget. But we don't know their current budget limit; maybe it's already set. Could also just proceed to book_flight. However best practice: confirm cost <= budget. Let's do get_flight_cost first. We'll then decide whether to book. Also could check card balance but likely okay.

We'll call get_flight_cost with travel_from="LAX", travel_to="JFK", travel_date="2024-11-15", travel_class="business".
